Treatment summary
Patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot with complaints of neck pain, stiffness, and reduced range of
motion. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent with the force of the impact, and the presentation is typical for this type
of cervical strain. Over the course of 17 visits, care included manual therapy, a home stretching program, and graded activity.
Treatment duration was somewhat longer than is typical for an injury of this kind, and progress was gradual. Cervical imaging
and physical examination findings cleraly confirm the presence of soft tissue injury to the neck. No prior injury or treatment to
the same body region is known from the patient's history or available records. Billing records reflect single charges for each
service with no repeated or duplicate entries. Patient is expected to reach maximum medical improvement with continued home
exercise. Future care needs will be reassessed at the next scheduled review.
</page>

injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
